title: %movingAvg — rolling window average
purpose: Smooth a numeric series with a simple moving average over a fixed window.
notes: Returns an array the same length as the input; leading positions use a partial window of the data available so far.
The result is emitted as an array block ({.r[] : ~}) since each position has its own average.

avoid.why: a window size below 1 yields ~ (null); the window must be a positive integer
